nodes.label: Fastlane Developer ID Distribution Workflow
nodes.rationale: Describes building and signing SimpleSimulatorManager for Developer ID distribution outside the Mac App Store.

nodes.label: fastlane match Signing Asset Management
nodes.rationale: match replaces manual Keychain Access setup and per-machine provisioning profile installs: builds automatically fetch, decrypt and install the Developer ID certificate and profile, so contributors need only MATCH_PASSWORD and SSH read access. Manual installs are explicitly discouraged because match re-handles them on every build.

nodes.label: simplesimulatormanager-certificates Storage Repo
nodes.rationale: Private repo where match stores the encrypted certificate and provisioning profile. It is the only place encrypted signing assets should live; access to it and to MATCH_PASSWORD is limited to people who build releases.

nodes.label: MATCH_PASSWORD Shared Secret
nodes.rationale: Decrypts the certificate/profile in the certs repo. It is a shared secret obtained from a maintainer, not self-generated; a wrong value fails decryption with a clear error.

nodes.label: App Store Connect API Key Authentication
nodes.rationale: APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_KEY_ID, _ISSUER_ID and _KEY_FILEPATH (.p8) authenticate both notarization and match against the Apple Developer Portal, deliberately avoiding Apple ID/password login and any 2FA prompt in automation.

nodes.label: .env Secrets File
nodes.rationale: A .env at the repository root supplies MATCH_PASSWORD and the App Store Connect API key values. It must never be committed, and its placeholder values must be replaced with real signing details before building.

nodes.label: fastlane mac build Lane
nodes.rationale: Builds and signs the macOS app for Developer ID distribution, performing a read-only match fetch as part of the build.

nodes.label: fastlane mac release Lane
nodes.rationale: Sets the release version, builds and signs, notarizes and staples with Apple, creates release/SimulatorManager.zip from the stapled bundle, and opens the release folder.

nodes.label: fastlane mac update_signing_assets Maintenance Lane
nodes.rationale: An occasional maintenance lane, separate from build, that pushes the Developer ID certificate/profile to the certs repo. It needs push access, so only maintainers run it; everyone else relies on automatic read-only fetches.

nodes.label: Apple API-Key Certificate Creation Restriction
nodes.rationale: Apple blocks creating a brand-new Developer ID Application certificate via API key ('only the Account Holder can perform this operation') — a Developer Portal restriction the project cannot work around. A genuinely new certificate must be created interactively via `fastlane cert` or the web UI by an Account Holder, then brought in with `fastlane match import`. Provisioning profile creation via API key is also sometimes rejected ('check with your Team Admins'), fixed by granting the key Admin access or importing a manually downloaded profile.

nodes.label: Notarization and Stapling
nodes.rationale: Because the app ships outside the Mac App Store, the release ZIP contains a stapled notarized bundle signed with a Developer ID certificate so Gatekeeper accepts it without the old notarization warning.

nodes.label: Signing Secrets Handling Rules
nodes.rationale: Never commit .env, MATCH_PASSWORD, exported .p12/.cer/provisioning profiles, or the App Store Connect .p8 key to this repo — the encrypted certs repo is the only sanctioned home for signing assets, and access to it is limited to release builders.

nodes.label: GitHub Release Publishing Steps
nodes.rationale: After a release lane run, artifacts land in release/; a GitHub release is created and SimulatorManager.zip uploaded so users can download and move the app into Applications.

nodes.label: Signing, Build and Notarization Troubleshooting
nodes.rationale: Checks MATCH_PASSWORD correctness, SSH access to the certs repo via git ls-remote, whether update_signing_assets has populated the repo, the shared SimulatorManager scheme, .env presence, and the .p8 key path/permissions for notarization.
